{{Top}}
{{Quote|Have you ever thought about sleeping, boss?''"<br />"''Which is, exactly, what?''"<br />"''Sort of like being shot until you're unconscious, except there's no bacta, and you often end up feeling better than when you started.|[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
[[File:AlderaanRoyaltyBelt.png|thumb|right|320px|Leia Organa sleeping]]
'''Sleep''' was a state of unconscious rest needed by a wide variety of [[Species/Legends|species]] across the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]], including [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]],<ref name="XW:WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref> and [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]].<ref name="Dreams of Grievous">"[[The Clone Wars: The Dreams of General Grievous]]"</ref> Interestingly, [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] required a fraction of the sleep Humans did, an ability that helped save [[Ooryl Qrygg]]'s life on [[Talasea]].<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> The [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] race of [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] also did not sleep. Instead, they would enter a trance, during which they were almost as aware of their surrounding as awake while receiving the same amount of rest as sleeping species do when asleep. Humans and other species typically slept at night, and it was considered a necessity for proper functioning and personal performance. Lack of sleep would induce less effective performance and a bedraggled appearance in Humans, although other species might manifest a lack of sleep differently.

REM sleep was a stage of sleep necessary to most beings. If a person did not get the acquired amount, there could be repercussions, ranging from depression, exhaustion and hallucinations all the way to a possible psychotic break.<ref name="The Last Jedi novel">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

Droids could, in a manner of speaking, also sleep when they entered a powered-down state from time to time.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Reportedly, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] killed his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] while the latter was sleeping.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Afterwards, Sidious himself did not sleep, determined not to make the same mistake as his master, possibly relying on the [[Force power/Legends|power]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to sustain himself.<ref name="darklord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> Similarly, as [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane]] grew more powerful in the dark side during his studies at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], he almost never slept. He found that it seemed his body no longer needed sleep, feeding on his growing command of the dark side. He relied instead on an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] or two of [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] each [[Standard day/Legends|day]] to keep his body energized and his mind invigorated. Nevertheless, even this power had its limits. After wandering for nearly two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] in the wastelands of Korriban with no sleep whatsoever, Bane returned to his room at the Academy and dropped into a deep, dreamless sleep within [[Standard second|seconds]] that lasted for several hours.<ref name="Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

===Sleeping locations===
[[File:QuietSteps-AoD.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]] sneak past a sleeping Rebel trooper]]
Humans and other bipedal species usually slept on beds or bunks, though this was not always true, especially for [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] far from buildings or [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Many ships, including the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], were equipped with cabins or bunks for the purpose of sleeping.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> On planets, hotels were businesses designed to provide a place to sleep and stay the night for travelers.<ref name="Fists of Ion">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> A common principle among military men was to sleep whenever one could wherever one could, a principle practiced by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] when she was a prisoner in [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] castle on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], during her tour of duty in the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]], sought out her parents' quarters and slept in their bed as it smelled like and reminded her of them, providing a more restful, relaxing environment for her to sleep.<ref name="Enemy Lines I">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>

===Dreams===
{{Main|Dream/Legends}}
{{Quote|I don't sleep well anymore.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] admitting his troubling visions to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
Some species experienced dreams while they slept. Jedi sometimes had visions of past, present, or future events while they slept. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had nightmarish visions of first his mother and later [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] dying and in pain that prevented him from sleeping well.<ref name="AOTC" /> The nightmares of Amidala eventually became so troubling to Skywalker that he chose to forsake sleep entirely, drawing upon reserves of energy from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] simply to keep him upright, though it could not give him rest.<ref name="RotSnovel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Later, his [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]] as [[Darth]] Vader caused him further difficulties with sleeping, due to the loud noise of the breathing and harshness on his throat. He also remained troubled by nightmares of Amidala.<ref name="darklord" /> [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|Disturbances in the Force]] could also cause Force-sensitives to awaken prematurely.<ref name="Enemy Lines II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref> While traveling in his [[Soulless One/Legends|personal starfighter]] to his [[Grievous's castle/Legends|lair]] on the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] dreamed of his past as a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and the glory of victories he'd won against his foes.<ref name="Dreams of Grievous" />

[[File:ObiSleeping-CW22.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Obi-Wan Kenobi sleeping prior to a [[Battle of unidentified planet (shielded city)|battle]]]]

===Attire===
Among some cultures, depending on economic advantage and circumstances, people wore specialized attire for sleeping, as opposed to their everyday attire. Padmé Amidala, for example, wore one of several nightgowns when she was preparing for bed or when she slept.<ref name="AOTC" /><ref name="ROTS" /> As a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Anakin Skywalker slept without a shirt or tunic, which was different from his typical daily [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]].<ref name="AOTC" /><ref name="ROTS" /> [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] undressed completely to sleep when he first joined [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="XW:RS" /> Similarly, on at least one occasion [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] slept without clothing save for an ornate red-and-gold floral robe that was opened wide.<ref name="Visions">''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]''</ref> Most beings also used [[Blanket/Legends|blankets]] or [[sleep sack]]s while sleeping and slept on a [[Sleeper (furniture)|sleeper]].
